## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC and TRA execution

- 2021-01-28: Business Combination Agreement signed between Andina Acquisition Corp. III and Stryve Foods Holdings, LLC; form-of TRA contemplated as a closing deliverable
- 2021-07-20: De-SPAC closed; TRA executed and filed as Exhibit 10.11 to the closing 8-K

#### Financial distress signals (TRA remains in force)

- 2023: Going-concern doubt first disclosed in the FY2022 10-K
- 2024-10-08: Nasdaq delisting determination letter received per the Q3 2024 10-Q

## Explanation

Stryve Foods, Inc. executed this TRA on July 20, 2021 at the closing of its de-SPAC business combination (Andina Acquisition Corp. III merging into an Up-C structure with Stryve Foods Holdings, LLC as the operating-partnership counterparty). The contract pays 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of Holdings Class B units and Class V common stock for Class A common stock, with Stryve Foods Holdings, LLC as the sole TRA Holder of record. The TRA carries a $0 balance on every Stryve balance sheet from execution through Q3 2024 because Stryve has been loss-making, maintains a full valuation allowance against the underlying deferred tax assets, and reports that TRA payments are not probable; the contract remains legally in force and would reactivate if Stryve returned to taxable profitability. A going-concern qualification appeared in the FY2022 10-K and a Nasdaq delisting determination was received in October 2024, so the firm's listing fate beyond that point is not yet visible in the directory. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
